# Domain Hound

> Ask Claude or ChatGPT for a name or domain. Get one you can buy.
>
> It checks the domain, the cheapest shop including renewal, the app stores and US trademarks, in one answer. Free.

Use this when you want to know if a domain is available and where it is cheapest, or when you need a good name for your business and have none yet. Domain Hound checks ten endings (.com, .ai, .io, .dev, .app, .co, .so, .sh, .tech, .inc) and finds the cheapest of six shops, renewal included. It shows the first-year price, renewal price and total cost over three years, and suggests cheaper endings. If your name is taken, it helps you find names with a meaning behind them, each with an available domain. It also checks app names on the App Store and Google Play, shows exact US trademark matches only, and shows other businesses found using the name. Similar names aren't checked for trademarks.

Buy opens the shop. Dated list prices, source shown. Trademark results are a search aid, not legal advice. No account, no cost.

Works in your agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) and on domainhound.dev. Made by BrightBoard AS. Privacy policy https://domainhound.dev/privacy/ and terms of service https://domainhound.dev/terms/

## Use Domain Hound

- [Website](https://domainhound.dev/). Search domains and find names in your browser. Buy opens the shop.
- [Hosted connector for Claude and ChatGPT](https://domainhound.dev/#install). Buy opens the shop.
- [Claude Code and Codex](https://domainhound.dev/guides/domain-hound-claude-code-codex/). Install the npm package with Node.js 20 or later. Never buys without your yes. With your Spaceship key and your yes, your agent can buy it and set up DNS.
  - Claude Code: `claude mcp add domain-hound -- npx -y domain-hound`
  - Codex: `codex mcp add domain-hound -- npx -y domain-hound`
  - Other local clients: command `npx`, arguments `-y` and `domain-hound`, transport stdio.

## Hosted connector tools

- `domainhound_check_domains` checks a name or domain, compares endings and prices, and checks app names on the App Store and Google Play. Exact US trademark matches only. Similar names aren't checked.
- `domainhound_generate_names` generates name ideas and checks their domains.
- `naming_brief` supplies a creative brief when your agent writes the candidates.
- `check_batch` checks up to 60 names from your agent and returns up to five picks with domain, app and trademark results.
- `domainhound_check_app_name` checks the US App Store and Google Play for a proposed app name.

## npm package tools

- `check_domains` checks availability and compares dated list prices, including renewal.
- `triage_names` finds names for an idea or checks a list of candidates.
- `check_batch` checks up to 60 names from your agent and returns up to five picks.
- `naming_guide` explains the naming method.
- `quote_domain` gets a live quote from Spaceship.
- `buy_domain` orders through your Spaceship account after you approve the exact price. Direct ordering is opt-in.
- `setup_domain` previews and applies approved website or email DNS changes in your Spaceship account.
- `taken_domain_dossier` looks for public information about a taken domain and available alternatives.
- `watch_domain` checks the registry, expiry and website for a taken domain.
- `move_domain` compares transfer and renewal prices.
- `my_domains` checks domains you own for expiry, DNS and renewal prices.

Share up to five shortlisted names from the results page. The shortlist travels after the # in a domainhound.dev/r/ link. The viewer reads it in the browser. Anyone with the full link can read it.

Website DNS presets cover GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify and Cloudflare Pages (www only). Mail presets cover Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Fastmail, Proton and iCloud.
